title: Ramp header
description: A two-tier top bar that stays pinned: a near-black announcement strip with an underlined link and a close button, then a white 62px nav with a wordmark, chevroned menu links, a quiet sign-in link and an acid-lime and a near-black button. Phones get a square grey menu button that opens a full-width panel.
notes: sticks to the top of the page (position: sticky), so it pushes the hero down instead of covering it
the announcement strip forces the theme's dark colours with the dark class
JavaScript only dismisses the announcement; the phone menu is a native <details>
name: ramp-header

props.name: brand
props.type: { name: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; }
props.description: the wordmark: a name in the display face, with an optional small icon after it

props.name: announcement
props.type: { text: string; link?: { label: string; href: string; }; }
props.description: the dark strip above the nav (leave out to hide it)

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the announcement's close button

props.name: login
props.description: the quiet text link on the right, e.g. "Sign in"

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the phone menu button
